A crisp early morning was pleasant enough. Fish were feeding, but pretty lethargic with the cold water temps. No giants, but several very nice brown trout. I missed several bites that were very light. One was a larger fish. Happy Fishing! R
Trimbell if I had to guess
A cold 18 degrees with clouds and wind. Water temp was a balmy 36.5 degrees. Several fish caught by fellow angler Shebs and Me. One larger fish on cam lazing around our feet. Happy Fishing!. R

Well, a full weekend of fishing leaves a lot of skunk until today. Some nice scenery and a mix of browns and brooks. I walked three different rivers in north and central WI. I will not be going back to two of them for sure. Enjoy. Happy Fishing.
Great bite today. Things seemed to heat up after the sun came out. Footage of first fish over 20" this season - lost it. Happy Fishing. R
Nice water. 20+ fish to hand. Shebs was kicking my ass in the beginning. Lots of quality fat brooks and browns. Happy Fishing! R
Great brook trout action here. Lotsa smalls, but some nice ones too. A few odd browns. Good bite and a lot of water covered. Happy Fishing! R

An amazing day here with another experienced angler. It's long but there are quality fish throughout, worth the watch :) A fat 4lb 17" brownand 13.5" Brook. This walk was well over three miles and worth every step. The 64gb mem card filled and there was about 1.5 hours ans 25 more caught and released. Happy Fishing. R

Great bite. Fish were certifiably bonkers. Lost a very big brown toward the end. 20"+. I would say it was s the largest inland brown I have ever come across. It hurt my hands on the strike. Happy Fishing. R
A very hot bite with many large browns. Last clip has a beast that came out and then swam away. Great to be back in the saddle. R
Well a very nice opener. Many quality brook trout caught today. Shebs and I limited out on foot or better brookies. I did not realize I had a smudge on lens. Note to self, clean the camera. R
Brook trout off the chain! Smalls but a ton of fun on a nice sunny warm spring day. The birds were nuts as well. I heard a call I have never heard before. Digging into that too. Happy Fishing. R
Happy Memorial Day Weekend. Great bite here and a few big fish!!. R
The best bite I have ever experienced. Happy Memorial Day. Thanks to all who serve in any way. No other words. R
First day out in a week due to work. I still remembered what I was doing :) Happy Fishing! R
An awesome sunny early evening. Some great scenery here. Lots of smalls and a cpl nice browns. One is a high flying tree wrapper. Enjoy!. R

Well an interesting day. Another 90 degree scorcher. The new Lews speed spin light reel that I liked broke. The bail spring bit the dust after one week of fishing. Will replace or return on warranty. Don't think I want another one :) Small browns and over all light action. One nice 15"+ brown. Good times. Troutstock 2016 underway. R

Troutstock 2016 closes with some small stream brook trout hunting. This water is too small for tandem fishing, but Shebs still caught the best fish of the day a 13.5" brookie. Very sunny day but the fish were active. Beautiful small stream. Happy Fishing. R

A heavy action night with three fish 16"+. Using a new reel Pfleuger Presidente. Hands down the best one I have used to date. Evening bite was strong herewith several consecutive periods of cast fish cast fish! Happy Fishing!. R

Well, first time out after my MC accident on June 17, 2016. 120 days ago I almost left this Earth and the people I love behind. So grateful! No monsters here, but in the limited ability window, there were fish. Casting was tough, wading tougher...pure nirvana. Happy Fishing and see ya in the early season. Peace.

Just scenery here. 7 degrees. I have never seen this much ice on our local streams. The recent sub zero nights and single digit days have taken hold. January will be tough as long as the freeze holds on. Happy Fishing! R
Wisconsin Trout Fishing - WI Opener - 1/7/2017 ~~COLD and ICY ~~

Beautiful February afternoon. Winds were low to none and the sun did not keep fish away. Lots of browns to hand. Also ran into two younger fishermen. Couple of smart dudes, check it out... and happy fishing!

Went on a bit of a hunt today before settling on a usual spot. Tested water at 36 and 38 degrees, which made for no trout feeding. Finally several browns to hand and the first fish caught by Shebs is a bit of a surprise. Happy Fishing. R

A couple of really nice browns, assorted brooks and my third tiger trout of the season. Happy Fishing! R

A phenomenal day had. 100+ to hand. Long video. Several larger browns, but no monsters. A secluded 4 mi. + walk kept any fair weather folks away on this special day :) Browns dominated 2 to 1, but my buddy found two large mouth bass as well. Not sure how they got there but they could not have been happy with water in the 40's. Lost the fish basket for a while, but it was found. I will not trust spring clasps anymore! Happy Fishing!! R

A couple of different streams on a crowded fishing day. Third stream was a charm. Walked up on another angler and fished for while. Fariq was throwing a small silver rapala that the fish hit and hit again. Some video of a new HI stretch. It looks like high quality work so far. Great evening fish. Happy Fishing! R

Well, there is only one fish video worthy today! A giant 23" Brown trout!! I had another 30 fish or so to hand, but really there is no reason to post those today. This big female is pushing 5# and was feisty as hell. Happy Fishing! R
Brook trout action here. Unfortunately I walked through 40+ fish with the camera off unknowingly. Still some nice action here, a few nicer brook trout. Happy Fishing! R
A beautiful evening fish. No big fish here. Over 20 browns to hand. Some awesome scenery and tranquil bright sun and shade. Happy Fishing!
A pretty sweet outing here. Over 60 fish to hand.90% brook trout. Best brook was a 15" brute. Best brown topped at near 16" Beautiful stream with deer and a late summer breeze. Happy Fishing! R
Hungry brooks and a rainbow. Some nice 14-15"spawning fish. Happy Fishing. R

Happy Fishing! Started with sunny, balmy 4F. Might have gone to 10F. Trust me that was warm compared to the recent weather. -20 here last night. Anyway only one take, four or five follows and some fish sightings. Ice here was not a significant issue. Was nice and warm even with a minor fall. Will be back at it tomorrow. R

A much warmer today with temps soaring to 26F. The browns where active with several aggressive fish to hand. One 18", a 16"+ and several other nice browns 13-15"ers. A flurry of muskrats around today as well, they were happy too. Happy Fishing! R

My fishing buddy Shebs and I began the day drooling over brook trout possibilities today, but confronted adversity. While upstream the water appeared clear and ice free, the best spots known to us on the stream for brookie hunting were frozen over. Plan B, off to another stream and thankfully no major ice cover. The water was clear, but cold, likely under 40F. The process started off with enthusiasm. After three hours of a bone chilling, toe numbing walk in the water with no fish hitting, bing! bang! boom! As has occurred at most outings this early season, the late afternoon provided some hot action. Must be some type of midge or nymph hatch that turns the fish on.
 Bing! A 16" thick brown.
 Bang!! A 20 1/4" fat ass big headed google eyed brown. My first 20 of the season and my third fish 18 or better in January.
 Boom!!! Shebs cashes in on fierce 15", 2.5#er brownie.
 In the course of an hour, 10 more fish, all browns. Like it began, it was over. By this point my toes were numb and i had enough. Shebs kept on fishing and I got a message about 8 more fish to hand. Good day folks, a very good day!
 
 Happy Fishing!
 
 R

The weather continues to dominate local trout fishing here in western WI. Oddly downstream was a bit warmer than headwaters today. Encountered some serious melt areas that were cool, but still only mildly stained. Many smaller browns here with my buddy. One nice 3# 17.75" brown in the montage and in the middle of this video. I am so ready for spring! Happy Fishing!! R

I found another tiger trout on this outing. Mostly smaller browns and brooks. I made effort to add more of the info about the lures I use and other tips. Some good footage pf pools of fish here. Happy Fishing R
Wisconsin Trout Fishing - Tiger # 2 this year

Came a cross a fat 4# 18.5 female brown this outing. Moved on with my buddy Shebs to the strangest bite I have seen this year. Loads of fish woul d only follow and make defensive kinda bites. Very obnoxious. They would come screaming at the lure and make one knock. A few fish to hand there in awesome conditions. Happy Fishing
Wisconsin Trout Fishing - 5th fish over 18" this season

Well the frost has let go. Streams in the area are taking on a lot of melt and a lot of water. After recon, found two spots that fished. A couple of fish to hand, but a pretty mediocre walk in the water here. Happy Fishing!

Well, an unexpected opener outcome. Picked very long remote section, but was not alone. Turned out the landowner hand a fish camp set up in the middle of the stretch. It was pretty picked over in the middle. Good time with buddies Nick and Shebs, fun was had by all. We harvested few nice grill sized brown trout. I had fresh chili-lime rubbed brown trout for din din. Happy Fishing!

Another beautiful outing here. We had thunderstorms locally last night and the water was not optimal. Still managed plenty of browns and brook trout in this spot. This stretch is long, but it has some great cliffs and rock formations. There is a big box turtle on cam here as well. With the limited visibility here, the fish were either lip biting or scarfing the whole lure. Nice WI landowner here, he always likes to chat a bit. Happy Fishing!

Happy Memorial Day! Thanks to all that have and will serve our country. A morning brown trout spectacular here. As our third day of 90+ degrees was approaching, I chose to get out early. Streams are still a bit stained from heavy rains late last week, but plenty of action here. Great morn! Happy Fishing!!

I stopped at a spot that I was hoping would be good, but it was too murky to justify the long slog. At the second spot, I had some trouble closing the deal as the fish were rambunctious, several lost nice fish here. I did find a few browns, including a 23" 4# + beauty. Unfortunately, I had paused the camera when the action occurred but the release is herein. This fish wallowed once and struck once before devouring my lure on the third strike! It peeled drag ferociously for 30-40 seconds and then rolled. He tied himself up like a bow on a Christmas present. A safe release was a good thing as the fish was wound up pretty good in braid, I had to cut it free. Happy Fishing!

Looking forward to the holiday this week. Heat advisory for the 4th at 95 and humid. I'll carry fluids for hydration and fish till my fingers bleed! Hahahaha!! Happy Fishing!!!

First stop at sunrise was a bust, but the second stop was epic. Many large browns prowling there today in moderately stained water. A 21" and 18" brown to hand was the best. Also caught a 23-24" northern. There were several larger trout missed by me today. Big fish density was high! Happy Fishing!!
Plan B - maybe lower in plum or somthing, hard to say.

A great outing here. The water was stained and fish were holding in pools and providing lazy bites. As the late morning moved on, I came across some bigger browns. Lost a 20"+ brown here in the middle. The whole debacle is covered. I was stubborn with a lure that was getting action, but must have had a bad barb as I have lost 3 nice fish in a row. Changed up and settled into a nice groove. Water clarity improved as I headed upstream as well. More than 40 to hand. Happy Fishing

Actually a couple outings here. Both with pretty minimal activity. I did catch and release my third tiger trout of the year though. Some beautiful water and scenery. The prolonged heat and heavy rain have put a damper on the what was an excellent July start, but I will keep trying. :) 92 here today. I will start at sunrise somewhere tomorrow and see if the coolest point of the day improves fishing outcomes. Happy Fishing!

A great outing here with some surprises. Over 50 fish to hand on a hot bite day. I found a fish even more unusual in a cold trout stream than a tiger. Early on I thought I may have encountered a new personal best fish, but it turned out to be an 18"+ small mouth. He was hungry enough to attack a spinner. Hahaha. Also, one big trout here too. 20+ although I did not get a tape on him as he thrashed out of net. With the lure still in his mouth I have learned not to grab and get stuck, so...that's the way it goes. May have been 22. Happy Fishing!

Multi spot day. Small browns to hand in the AM. Met with fishing buddy Shebs and a high quality outing with brook and brown trout was had. The best fish of the day, an 18"+ big pig was unable to be filmed as I was out of battery power. Several nice 15 16 17 18" browns to hand here. There is a crazy clip of a 13" brown that hit a lure 15-20 times before taking the lure. Pretty awesome. 40+ fish to hand and cpl on the stringer as well. Happy Fishing!

Only one video clip is worthy from today. I managed to hook up with a 20.25" fat female brown this afternoon while fishing with my friend Mark. A tremendous battle ensued. Beautiful fish safely released. I managed to cut screaming and profanity :) Happy Fishing!

A great outing here with several larger brown trout being the highlight. This is a flatter, sandy section of the stream. Gnats were very unpleasant today. Mid 80s heat was tempered with a mild breeze. Encountered one very large brown that got the best of me. Several brook trout as well here. The days are shortening and the best fishing of the year is near. Happy Fishing!

Early afternoon, long haul here. One of my favorite sections. 
  The prior flooding in late June did a major renovation since the last time I was here. Fantastic browns and brookies. 50+ fish to hand. Another monster contact without results, but a fat 19.5" consolation brown. The first was 25"+. That kind of thing just stokes the fishing fire! Happy Fishing!

My buddy Justin was here celebrating his birthday today! Trout fishing never fails to put a smile on a face. Beautiful section here, one of the top 5 most beautiful streams I have ever walked. Pretty good bite with brook trout and then BAM! the occasional tank brown!! A cpl 17s and 16s here. A beaver family is on cam here too. All in all about 25 fish to hand over a longish 6 hour wade. Happy Fishing!!!

Well the heat and drought persists. There was some rain near this stream yesterday bit there was no effect on the creek. A 50/50 brown to brookie ratio here. Lost a bigger brown and did a bit of climbing in this section. The June floods actually cleared it out a bit, usually need the machete. Best browns at 15 16 and some 13 brookies. 20 or so to hand and another 10-20 nippers. Happy Fishing!

Welcome to big sucka Sunday! Hahaha. Hunting for bigs; Shebs and I came across some pike infested water. With the low water and continued heat the pike have moved into the colder water in this stream. A few cuss words here that I could not cut, so if that offends you pass on this one. When pike spoil the day, swearing is bound to happen. :) Pike were coming 5 to 1 on the first stop. We did sight several large 20+ browns, but for whatever reason they were not in the striking mood. We could use some rain in this area. 
 Happy Fishing!
Clearly lower in the river, Buffalo if I had to guess

Got in a fish with my buddy Alex in the early AM before heading off to my annual, friendly, bass tourney. Was hoping for a big fish, but it was not to be. Several nice browns and brookies here. 20+ fish to hand, but the monsters evaded us on this gloomy cool morning. Alex hooked in to a low 20s pike here as well. That's a first for this particular stream. Happy Fishing!
Lower in the river again, I suspect this might be Plum

Well I was hoping for rain, but this is a bit ridiculous. Most areas received 2 to 6" here, far worse south and north. Fishing may be down for a while until the water recedes. While on the way home from bass fishing, I couldn't find a stream for 180 miles, but then 10 minutes from the house, I was able to get a short jaunt done! Happy fishing!! A very cool 16" brown dink and dunk here.

Labor Day weekend fishing ends with a bang. Probably the most prodigious bite of the year so far. Near 70 to hand, some lost as well! Browns dominate here with a few brookies tossed in. Best brown was a 16.5" bruiser! Lots of 10 to 12 inch fish. Not sure why they were bonkers. There did not seem to be any special surface or subsurface activity besides browns attacking lures with abandon!! Happy Fishing!!!
The owner of this location is a total ass hat, if you are ready to get yelled at it's a good spot, personally I avoid this one.

The twin towers are on my mind today. I am thankful for all sacrifices made by men and women to keep our country safe! A late afternoon drop in here post some significant flooding made for a challenging outing. The star of the show is a big fat 4# 
 19+" brown near the end. About 15 or so to hand on this short outing. Happy Fishing!

Another amazing brook trout outing here. 50+ to hand and some nice 15s and 14s, and some dinks too! Hahaha. The fish were bonkers mid day. I started early and went on to plan B which turned out epic. I had a pair of fish follow a lure down and the free fish mirrored every movement of the hooked fish for 30 secs or so. 
 Shebs joined later, but the hot bite had mostly passed. Harvested a 17" brown out of these brookie waters. That fish looked like it had eaten quite a few brook trout recently! Fat!! Happy Fishing!!! Season closes in less than month.

Putting some additional time in before the season closes. My buddy Justin and I made a long wade and were rewarded with an excellent outing. 40+ fish to hand with another 10-20 misses, follows and lost. Best brown here was 16.5" Best brookie was 13.5". We had our chances on bigger fish today too. By guess, we missed or lost 3 18"+ and 1 20"+ browns. This stream was in good shape and cold cold cold. No thermometer but the is water was close to 50F. Chillingly numb to fingers in less than 5 seconds. Happy fishing for at least two more weeks!! :(

Today started as a big brown hunt! However, while that did not materialize, a superb brookie outing was had!! The quality of brook trout in this video is amazing. I caught a 16" and four other fish 15"+. Many 12-14"ers as well. There are a few dinks mixed in, but for about 2.5 hours it seemed there was a pernicious brookie under every rock, stone and log. Also, seems my venerable Sony AS200V might be giving up the ghost. The stable shot tech is faulty. Went through a hard reset and will see if that helps. If not a new cam in time or I may move to the very wide angle without steady shot. 14 days left in the in land season, hoping for some stable weather conditions to close the year. Happy Fishing!!!

Well up north was a complete wash out bust. I headed down state yesterday and had yet another great brooking outing. 2 rainbows and an unfortunate deep hooking of a 16 brookie on the stringer. Lots of rain coming nest week, this may be one of the last outings of the season! Happy Fishing!

With the impending heavy rain coming, this may be the closer of inland season! Two stops. First, alone on a small stream, I found brookies and a 16" brown that I harvested for the benefit of the brookies :) Second stop was an epic brook trout outing. Over 60 to hand. A tree fish. A seven fish hole. Many dbls. Good times with fishing pro Shebs! Hopefully we won't get flooded out too badly. Happy Fishing!!

SNOW!!! Can't remember Oct 14 sticking snow, but it's icing on the cake for one of the strangest weather/trout seasons I can recall. Good news, not blistering cold :) The brown trout here were mostly aggressive with a few slow biters getting away. No dinks, all 12 - 15" fatties. This may be the last outing for my 2018 inland season - a weird, but good season! Stay tuned for lake runners! Early season 2019 starts January 6th. Happy Fishing!

Well, this outing puts inland 2018 in the books. A brisk day with some pretty cold wind out there. At least no snow today! Came upon a beaver dam that fudged up the second half of this outing. 20 or so browns with a cpl brookies tossed in. Best fish a bit over 15". Thanks for watching! Will be targeting a few lake runner outings, but things will slow quite a bit until 1/6/2019!! Happy Fishing!!!

Hot diggigty dog! Trout fishing season is open. Whew! I almost didn't make it. :) A great opener here. 32 degrees at 7am had me worried about run off and snow melt, but was not an issue. 30+ fish to hand. Since the early season began in WI, I had only been greeted with single digits temps on past Jan openers. Comfortable weather and good water conditions made for a strong bite. No bigs, but no dinks either. Happy Fishing!
Today was a much more normal January fish outing. 15 or so to hand with Shebs bagging more than half of them. Short outing with decent action. Happy Fishing!
Cold late afternoon fish. A few humble browns. Two days of video upcoming, along with the end of our local cold snap. Happy Fishing!

A new water excursion. The water here was not high, but incredibly swift. Temps in the 30s made for a nice full day. 20 or so fish to hand. Numerous follows and single tap biters. Hit three different areas on the stream system. Mostly browns with a few rainbows mixed in here. No giants, but some nice healthy fish for sure. Going big brown hunting tomorrow! Happy Fishing!!

Well big brown hunting was very slow. Water temps were very cold. I did get my first fish of the year over 18". The catch is not on film, but the 19" fat brown is filmed in hand and released. Shebs found a couple of nice brookies too. I picked up a nice brown at a bonus stop on the way home. There is some bonus footage of Shebs with his 24" brown mount. It turned out real well. If you need a taxidermist near Rochester MN, Shebs mentions his name. Looks like things are going to cool down quite a bit the rest of January. Need around 24F to keep the reel and pole working. Happy Fishing!

Well with the POLAR VORTEX coming and threatening to end trout fishing for 2 or 3 weeks, I took a vacation day and got out there! Nice clear water on a beautiful driftless stream. I had a buddy get into a very large trout in this system a week or so ago, so I went on the hunt for a big brown. A few lure selections shown here and about 20 or so fish to hand. No bigs, with the best fish at 16". All browns. Again, water temps were cold, but the fishing weather was great! Polar vortex says single digit/teens high temps and down to -teens at night low temps for 2 or 3 weeks. Trout fishing is not ice fishing :) and I strongly recommend no one mess around with those conditions. The trout will not be biting well and stream can kill in single digit temps. Happy Fishing!

Holy crap, the polar vortex is sucking the life out of western WI. :) I have some extra footage of temping area streams this morning. It was a balmy 0 degrees. A big pack of suckers sighted. Some general insight here on how I select cold trout fishing sites. A major fail with Vanish flourocarbon, don't even know why I tried. Power rules and I also show some ways to manage ice on the line. Getting going I had three bites with 2 browns to hand. The biggest fish is on film but I could not land it. My guess is somewhere around 16". I think I will wait out the vortex. Supposed to stay cold her for 2 to 3 weeks, Happy Fishing!

Quite a few of the area streams were still frozen over.. Things should improve tomorrow before a significant melt. Temps are supposed to rise to near 40 so I will be out early and give it a try! Happy Fishing!! Go RAMS!!!

Congrats NE Patriots. Before the game, I found a few spots to fish that were not yet in full melt. Foggy and pleasant conditions with a slow bite. 10-15 to hand with a brookie in the end out of a tiny ditch hole I check every now and then when I drive by it. No bigs here, but a fun time was had. Happy Fishing!

Pretty brutal out there folks. 20"+ of snow on the ground and 20F for a high temp. The fish were not having any of it. A rare SKUNK today! Not even a follower. There are some nice winter scenes here, but I won't take a thumbs down personally ! Happy Fishing!!

A pretty chilly start to the day. The wind was rough on fingers! No skunk today!! A few decent browns and a brookie to hand. Water was a balmy 36.9F and after the first hour or so it was quite comfortable. Happy Fishing!

Happy Presidents' Day. I hit this same section 2 years ago and it was epic Today, we are in deep winter with no melt off yet. It was a bit colder today, but brilliant sunshine abounded. 15 or so to hand, all browns. Best was a near 16" skinny fish. I had about an hour of non-stop bites, preceded by a generally poor bite for three hours. The tungsten 1/4oz. spinner was up to the job. It's nice having a heavy PM size 4 lure in some of the holes and trenches in this stream section. Happy Fishing.
I could probably figure this out.
An attempt before yet another foot of snow and a blizzard expected here in WI. A few browns to hand. Some nice winter scenery here. Happy Fishing!
An attempt before yet another foot of snow and a blizzard expected here in WI. A few browns to hand. Some nice winter scenery here. Happy Fishing!

Well I wasn't skunked, but the bite was tenuous today. No dinks, all 12 - 15" browns. Shebs managed four and I had one and a half. hahaha, The water was affected by some melting as we fished. Water temp at the start was a chilly 36.1F. Also had to make a guess as this spot had several anglers present. We guessed wrong. Ran into some nice folks that were working downstream. I would mention that it is best to work upstream to keep some order in the world and to catch trout. If you work down stream and are full wading, the kicking up of sediment and sand will alert fish and you will have a poor outing. As I post this video, the blizzard has officially hit. Several 5 foot drifts apparent in the yard and the front door is covered in. Come on spring! Happy Fishing!!

Snow, snow and more snow. First few spots had some skim ice, but I searched and found a familiar spot to get in. 3 swipers, but none to hand...SKUNKED!! You never can tell what will happen in early season, but there is some decent scenery video here. Happy Fishing!

Well I tried an afternoon drop in. I cam upon Jason and Wes shortly after I entered. They had come from further downstream and I asked to walk up with them. Wes had mentioned he saw a few of my videos, so I figured they must be decent, respectable people. :) Winter still has it's claws on western WI. The air temperature today was the warmest it has been in a week. Melt off was ongoing , but no torrents or cooling were evident. The deep snow and muck proved to be a major obstacle the whole afternoon. Jason had the most appealing lure, a Mepps Comet #2. He had three or four to hand, including the fish of the day a brown at 15- 3/4". Jason probably had ten other hits, nudges etc. Overall the fishing was pretty poor, but a fun time was had. Happy Fishing!
Well, the melt is on full strength near me! Some pics of water over the roads. Not a trout in sight! Might still be a week before fishing can occur. Happy Fishing.

Finally found a stream nearby that had enough clearing to wade the main stem. Wind was fierce out of the north and made for a cool fish. 7 fish, all browns and a couple missed. Glad I still had a pair of my nitrile gloves in the car. Might have packed it in if I hadn't. Spring steelhead in WI opened today as well, but i do not do opener for steelhead as it is just too much a circus show with many anglers everywhere. Planning a longer outing for tomorrow. Hopefully less windy and a bit warmer. Happy Fishing!

Well this video is a long day of several streams in southwestern WI with my buddy. We hit several streams. Bluebird skies, mostly stained water and a stiff wing made for tough conditions. Unlike my home territory, the land we targeted was all eased public fishing grounds. Highlights include a cpl 14"+ brook trout and a 17" brown. My buddy also had a 17" brown and several additional fish off camera. Being on small stream banks lends itself to serial fishing instead of dual wading. Also typical to this area is that streams are in pastures not woods. Fun has had by all and probably 35 or so fish to hand between us. Happy Fishing!

This video starts off with a bang! The first fish is a fat 3 to 4lb. 18" brown from earlier this weekend. Yesterday was a trip to dinkville. 15 to 20 browns from 6 to 12", with most to hand and several light biters that got free. Happy Fishing!

Got out early to beat the impending melt. The water was gin clear, but only small browns around today. Beautiful colors and active fish abound. 20+ to hand on a crisp morning that went from overcast to brilliant sunshine. Steelheading vacation starts Friday after work! Happy Fishing!!

Day 1 of my vacation started. I stopped midpoint to do some stream fishing. I will be focusing on steelhead the rest of the week. Some nice browns here. Pretty stream. Best fish was a 16"er. Happy Fishing !

A quality WI outing here. On some water that I could see the bottom! LOL Unfortunately, after 9 days of fishing I was used to having all my gear packed, but I left my trout vest and all gear, including tackle, scissors, and cam batteries in the garage :( To conserve batteries (2), you will get rapid fire catches only here. Shebs went 0/3 on big browns. They were the only 3 bigs we saw, unfortunately they picked on Shebs. About 40 fish. Some nice 13s 14s 15s, brookies and browns. Another first for me here was running into obviously stocked catchable size fish. They were hoarding at the bridges and clearly were not terribly smart fish. The will be table fare on opener and big brown fish food after that. Happy Fishing!

Merry Fishmas Day! An etiquette lesson starts this video. I purposely tried to get to a remote place so I would avoid any crowd. As I was getting in the stream at the bridge, two guys proceeded to trespass and walk the bank to move in front of me. I assume they are not the land owners. Given that they wouldn't even talk with me, I assume they are not and probably did not have permission from the landowner. If you get to a bridge and planned to do more than bridge fish, think it through. If a car is already there, the angler has probably gone upstream and you should simply just move on to a different section. A few cuss words here. Eventually they walked back out and left. Several nice brookies and browns at this first stop. I then met up with Shebs and we went looking for larger brown trout. The bite was slow and the wade was long. Shebs took me to the tool shed on this afternoon. He had me by fish count and caught the larger fish. About 14 to hand total for me. Happy trout season and happy fishing!

Well, opening weekend 2019 is in the books. A much better bite here with 35-40 browns and brookies to hand. Ran into three different anglers and my humanity is restored. A nice guy fishing a landlocked steel bridge, a family fishing, and a guy and his kid ready to fish at the out bridge. All nice and happy people! Small fish were the deal today. Browns from 7-13" and brookies at about 8-10". If you look closely you will see a big brown (20+) cross the river from bank to bank, but he wasn't feeding. Another beautiful weather day and a great day to fish! Happy Fishing!!

A short, early evening outing here. A few fish to hand and plenty of saturated, battered stream conditions. the winter and spring flooding has been pretty bad around here. Lastly, I took some footage of a new HI project setup. It's a big project and a long way from done. Happy Fishing!

Well, the rain continues. Most area streams are full, but beginning to clear up. On this day, my buddy Mark came over from the east side of the state and we gave it a faithful effort. The fish were a bit lethargic and slow biting. 20+ fish, mostly browns with some brookies mixed in. Best brookie was at 12.5"and the best brown near 15". Good times with a good friend. Thanks for watching and happy fishing!

An early evening brookie attempt here. Not stellar, but ten or so to hand. Things are progressing very slowly this season. The heavy winter run off and pernicious flooding has really done a number on streams, The fish are not yet settled into a pattern that is predictable. Some pretty brookies here. Happy fishing!

Nice warm day here today. A brown trout outing here. Still no significant caddis hatch, but several fish to hand. No bigs, but some healthy looking fish none the less. Ran into a few folks while fishing. The streams are battered and scoured. A few more weeks are needed to get things into full swing, Happy Fishing!

In moments before the next predicted flood, I managed an amazing outing here. Browns and brook trout to hand. Browns up to 17" with many quality 14-16" fish. A couple of 14" brookies and many other smaller brookies too. Around 50-60 fish to hand in a place with the most amazing limestone cliffs. I was glad to get this outing in. Depression was setting with the prospect of more gully washing flooding set for this weekend. :) LOL Happy Fishing!

Some central sands combat fishing! A small stream with plenty of brush and tannin stained water. 25 or so to hand with more brookies than browns. Best brookies were 12". Best brown was 15". I saw a few larger fish scurry from undercuts and timber. This water was quite a bit warmer than driftless water, but this place is beautiful. Happy Fishing!

Happy Memorial Day Weekend! Thanks to all that serve and the debts paid for our freedom!! Lots of fishing planned. We dodged the rain bullet today, so it looks like an excellent couple days ahead. Starts out here with a plethora of small browns on two short early evening stops. Most fish were 8-10 and none bigger than 12". All browns. This stream has been wiped by this year's flooding. Timber gone and many holes blown flat. In an area of rushing water, I did not hear the battery ding, so the best hole is not on film. Booo. Six or seven same size smaller browns to hand there, for a total of 22 to hand in about three hours. Pretty decent bite, but no big boys showed themselves. Happy Fishing!!!

No wind, sunshine and mid seventies made for a great late afternoon early evening fish. About 20 browns to hand. Some awesome eagles footage. I could feel the wind on the back of my neck on two swoops. They were not pleased I was in their river. hahaha. I did get one brookie as well but no film of that catch. Happy Fishing!

A short evening outing here. I love daylight savings time! Smalls including browns and a lone brookie. The gnats are out in force and with 80+ degrees forecast, the scourge of mosquitoes shall begin!! Some extra discussion on the river about the lures I use is here too. Happy Fishing!!!

Well the morning started out on fire! First fish was a dbl wide fat 16" brown and several timber crushers ensued. A beaver shot is here as well, so something for everyone!! Two other stops with Shebs. The first was a complete bust. The second was pretty low action to finish the day. Awesome weather and a spectacular morning 1.5 hour fish. Happy Fishing!

Not sunrise, but out early to make effort at the long stretch I started a cpl days ago. 30 or so to hand here. Came across a 16" + brown that was brutalized by a heron. Pretty gnarly wound and discoloration. I was surprised the bird didn't get him. Either way he had vigor, maybe he will live through it. Another beautiful day on the stream was had. Happy Fishing!

Fishing with Sasquatch and Mike up north. No sign of any fall back steelhead. Pretty slow day. Happy Fishing!

Well after a skunk outing with Sasquatch and Mike in the AM, I hit some up stream sections up north and found some clear water and eager fish. Brooks, browns and rainbows to hand here. Small fish were killing the 1/2oz+ spinners. Fish were feeding on other fish and coughing them up. Happy Fishing!
An evening drop in here. Small browns and brookies was all I could muster here. A LMB at the end was the signal to move on! hahaha, Happy Fishing!!

A good outing here with a tank of a brown near the end. The gnats are unbelievably obnoxious. While better than mosquitoes, not much! Hahaha. This evening drop in started slow and then I came upon browns feasting on rock hatching bugs, caddis would be my guess. Although things have been late, better late than never. Happy Fishing!

Shebs and I had a high quality outing here. Best fish being a fatttttt! 17" brown with several decent brookies as well. Thunderstorms were in the area, but the water was in good shape and the fish eager! There is some cussing that could not be cut, so if this offends you please do not watch. :) Happy Fishing!

Happy Father's Day to all! A great outing here. Shebs and I went on a long wade that started painfully slow, but ended up in bonkers mode!! A 14+" brookie, an 18" brown, a 17" brown and about 50 total quality trout to hand. Also, if the gnats are pestering you, I have the solution. Douse a cloth in vanilla extract. If you use the cloth to dab your neck, ears, and face there will be no gnats buzzing around your head. Happy Fishing!

A super hot bite this evening. I was in at about 6:30pm and had more than 10 fish in the first hour! All browns and no giants, but great action!! I can't recommend vanilla extract enough for gnat control. It works :) Very amped up browns. I lost several due to running and jumping. Happy Fishing!!!
A small stream outing here! The bite was fast and furious. There is a half hour or so here with more than 20 brookies and browns to hand. Mostly smaller fish, but big time fun!! Happy Fishing!!!

A brookie attempt here. Pretty slow bite. A few nice fish to hand over three different stops. A 14+ and a cpl 13s are the highlights. Some tiny guys as well. Nice to be out in the late afternoon. Gnats and mosquitoes kept at bay with vanilla extract! Happy Fishing!

Best action and bite of the weekend. Many browns to hand here. I ended up getting cut off by mares with foals present. Not something you should mess around with. The horses here have tried to stomp me before, so I went onto a second spot and caught another bunch of browns in an hour stretch. Lost the best encountered brown, probably 15-16" Great weekend! Looks like some storms and rain return for a few days. Happy Fishing!

A late evening drop in here before T-storms that passed just south of me. 15+ fish to hand, including a token brookie! A major new beaver dam has put some hurt on the stream!! Some nice brown trout here. Happy Fishing!!!

10+ fish to hand in an hour and a half. Mostly solid 16, 15 and 14s. Unfortunately a water spot found it way onto the lens, Another beaver dam has been built here and is wreaking havoc with the flow and level of the stream, Dam beavers! Lost two fish in the 18 to 20" range. Happy Fishing!!

Interesting morning, a tstorm sprung up to ruin the day. It starts hot with 5 fish in the first 40 minutes before the storm. A nice brookie to hand and the day fades to black and rain right on video. Happy Fishing!

4th of July Fireworks here this morning. I tangled with 4 browns over 20" today! You'll have to watch to see what happened!! 50+ fish to hand with browns over brookies 3 to 1. Used a mix of lures from 1/4oz to 1/2oz. Some dinkers as well. Ran into another angler and managed to get a lift back to my in spot. Saved me about an hour off my walk. Happy Fishing!!

This outing starts with brookie headwaters hunting and ends with my buddy and I trying out a part and additional section area of the brown trout fantasy land I stumbled on last week. The conditions were different and so was the bite. Many more brookies as expected, but a few nice browns too at 19 and 18. As sunlight begins to wane, the fish will begin to move to spawn areas and the coldest areas of streams. Thanks for watching and happy fishing!

Another evening drop in with Shebs. Really only one fish worth discussing. Shebs landed a 20" timber crusher with a pinpoint 8 foot cast! A few other small fish in an otherwise slow outing. Once the heat dipped it was a nice evening on a beautiful stream, Happy Fishing!

An evening outing far from home. Missed one bigger fish. Browns, bows and a brookie to hand. Storms threatened but stayed away! Happy Fishing!!

I found some clearish water! We have had so much rain here the past few days, I figured I'd be going for a country car ride. Stopped at a familiar spot and had a pretty good outing. A cpl of 17" browns and my first tiger trout of the year! Happy Fishing!
A early evening drop in here. Both Shebs and I barely avoided getting skunked. Hot afternoon with small fish and a poor bite. Happy Fishing!

This outing starts with an evening drop in. After a few nice browns in low water conditions, I realized I had lost my camera batteries. I made an attempt to find the seven batteries the next day! A few additional browns in the same section and a bit of scouting. Dirty and high water remains an issue in my area. Hopefully the rains will stop sometime this year! Happy Fishing!!
Rains continue to pummel the area. Crazy wet year! I tried a dirty water spot and then met up with Shebs. Some nice brookies here. Lost one large one! Happy Fishing!

An evening brook trout outing here. Plenty of fish around with many swipers and let offs that didn't make film. Mostly smaller fish. I kept waiting for the pigs to pounce...but not today! Happy Fishing!!

New water outing here. More browns than brookies. Very fat fish, obviously not missing any meals. Outing ends sourly. Some angler harassment with a guy on a dirt bike tossing sticks and rocks into the stream ahead of the wade. Of course in WI every citizen has a right to publicly access trout streams. Guess he didn't know he was camera. Oh well, you can't change people, they do what they do. Happy Fishing!

Three stop outing here. My buddy Nick and I came across some very nice brook trout action here. With full sun, the fish were hunkered under timber. Nick had a 15 and several 13 & 14"ers. I missed several the same size. Harvested a 15" rainbow and had a great time out there. 30+ fish to hand. Happy Fishing!

We got a lot here. Eagles, Gamera, and some brown trout! An evening drop in that was a bit down from my expectations. However, a beautiful evening to be on the stream!! Happy Fishing!!!
A great outing here. 6 browns 16" or better, with a few brookies mixed in. Best fish was a fat 19" and I lost one larger fish. Beautiful weather here. A great day on the stream! Happy Fishing!!

Well I finally made it back! My wife and I closed on a home this month, so first things first!! A short after dinner drop in here. A few average browns to hand. Felt great to be back on a stream!!! Happy Fishing. Should have some exciting stuff for this weekend. A spawn comes the fishing gets better and better. Lake runners around the bend too.

A great outing here. Three browns over seventeen and many other quality fish. A compliment of dink brookies as well. Good action until I hit a flat flood damage area of the stream. Brilliant afternoon sunshine! Happy Fishing!!

A slow start, but I did set a new record. I hit a 20" brown and a tiger trout on this outing. Beautiful fishing weather, overcast, cool and cold water. All together, my buddy Brad and I managed about 20 to hand. Great day! Happy Fishing!!

Had to travel around a bit to get a bite. One fish in the first two stops! I returned to the back half of where I ended two days ago. Some decent action. I saw two very large browns with no hook ups. One of em got beat out by a sixteen and the other swiped three times and missed the lure each time. Some decent brookies here today as well. Happy Fishing.

Made it to a spot with Shebs that almost never clears. Water was good, numbers were low. Several quality 13 14 15" brookies here. Oddly enough, all brookies here. Happy Fishing!

Brook trout mayhem here! A great outing that started slow and then exploded. A little drizzle. A little climbing. A hair under 17" giant broodstock brookie. I know it's a stocked fish, but the thing was nasty, fat and big! Lotsa of quality brookies. 4 browns, the best one to hand a 16". 40+ to hand. I lost a larger brown that was hooked up for a cpl seconds. I saw a second brooder that swiped three time at my lure, but I think it was too fat to catch it!! hahaha Happy Fishing!!!

With not much water yet ready to fish, we settled on some usual spots. Bite was good, not great. Brookies and browns here. A nice 18 and I lost a monster before Shebs showed. Happy fishing!

Lake run - Day 1. Plenty of fish sighted, but they where a bit skittish. Probably saw 10-15 lake runners come at lures, but backing off at the last second. On hook up on a nice big salmon. It looks kinda yellow coming in like a brown, but that s due to the water color. Close in before coming off, pretty clear it's a salmon. Some nice resident fish here too. Happy Fishing!

Lake run - Day 2
 I hooked into a nice 24.5" lake run brown here. A few other resident fish too. Pretty slow action on some mildly stained water. I'll be back in a cpl weeks. The conditions should be good for full blown salmon mayhem! Happy Fishing!!
Lake Run Day 3. More scenery than fish here. Heavy rain in the area put a damper on my plans. Several stops in the beautiful north woods. A few fish to hand. Happy Fishing!

Late afternoon drop in driftless water. One nicer brown at 16 and a gaggle of 8 to 13s. New stream to me again here. Beautiful scenery and stained water. I did hook one larger fish but I never got a glimpse of it before spitting the hook. 
  Hoping the rain stays away for some lake run fishing next weekend. Happy Fishing!

Shebs and I checked out a lower section in search of brown trout. Shebs had a nice 17" to hand on what otherwise was a slow bite. A nice 13+ brookie nearly bonks himself into a log trying to strike the lure. Rain up north is threatening to shut down salmon fishing up north, boo! Happy Fishing!!
They tend to look for big browns lower in streams this time a year.

Here is some local mud fishing. It was better than northern WI mud fishing! Salmon search up north was a complete bust due to heavy rains and poor water conditions. I will give it a couple more tries before end of the season. Here I ran into a near 18, lost a similar sized one, and several other thick brown trout. 9 DAYS LEFT for inland trout. Happy fishing.

Well 6 days left for inland fishing in WI. This is possibly the last weather day for fishing. More rain on the way. Shebs and I managed several nice browns, with three in the 16-17" range. Very colorful fish on a calm nice fall evening. A surprise tree fish here as well. The cam batteries that took an overnight stay in the river a couple months ago are dropping like flies. Happy Fishing!

2 days left for WI inland trout fishing. Today started cold, but 40 was welcome, even a bit of sun. The bite was good with 20+ browns to hand here. Best brown was 15.5" with the average fish coming in closer to 9". Lots of cover and timber fishing today, but strikes were purposeful and direct. Might be my last inland outing of the season. Happy Fishing!

I know I can't get out tomorrow, so today was my closer. Came across some awesome on fire colored up brookies. Had two large browns 18 and 17" to hand. It's sad to see another season end. A couple lake run trips are in the card, but will need mother nature to cooperate with my plans hahaha. Early season begins the first Saturday in January. Happy Fishing!

This has been a special day in year's past, with some epic results. 2020 began very mild, but then the cold and snow has dominated. This is a 3 stop day. My desired spot was frozen solid. 2nd stop was very slow and I walked out at the 3 hour mark. Third spot is near me and I found some fish. A nice outing here. Saw a couple brookies, but browns were hitting here today. A very nice fat 18" and many in the 15 to 12 range too. Had a larger fish flash and swipe w/o hookup. This stream appears to fair mostly well following the flood of 8"+ of rain last Monday. Pretty hot day still as the dog days of summer continue. Happy fishing!

An evening drop in here on a stream that has been ravaged by the recent flooding. This stream was straightened and damaged. It is scoured and featureless in some areas. Also has a few new holes created. There are a few fish to hand, but really, it's gonna take a while for the fish to return to comfort. Far less timber. The roads were obviously damaged and much fill and repair was done. Looks like the small bridges held here, but it is wrecked. I am encouraged that the uncovering of rocks and removal of silt, which generally means better natural reproduction for trout in the future. This might take a few seasons to return to some normal. Happy fishing!

A nice outing here with over 30 fish to hand. A nice, 17.5" and two or three other fish 16+. A few brookies as well. Strange here is five fish were foul hooked, most ever. 2 get to the stringer. Some tips on fishing techniques as well as lure selection here too! Happy fishing!!

Another high quality outing here. I managed to catch TWO tiger trout here. Shebs was a proud witness :) Tigers are estimated at 1:10000 odds. The tiger trout is a natural sterile hybrid of brook and brown trout parents. 40+ fish to hand including a 17" brown and nice brookies and browns of assorted sizes from dinks to 14". This stream ends with a new stretch of HI that looks more like flood control vs. true habitat improvement. Time will tell. There is some cussing here. If you do not care for that, please skip this one. Happy fishing!

Tale of two spots here. First spot, many many nipping fishing. For whatever reason, fish were bumping and following lures here. I have put the thermometer back in the fish mobile. I wanted to be sure that I am not unnecessarily stressing trout due to warm water. Happy to say, the streams today where in upper 50s F. Given the hot July, I do not expect streams to warm much more this season. As the cool nights return, the temps will plummet in the best streams to upper 40s and low 50s. Great WI Driftless cold water streams! On stop 2, I hit a small new-to-me section. Was pleasantly surprised with some very high quality brookies in the 14-15 inch range. Happy fishing!!

Two spots here! I started in a big brookie area and was not disappointed. 6 fish over 12" in the first 25 min. Hot hot hot!! I noticed some grass greening up and water will settle in to a spring phase soon. Even a heavy snow will not return freeze to the soil. the angle and duration of the sun mean too many daylight hours for a hard freeze to return. Happy fishing!

A pretty good brookie outing here with some browns thrown in too. The water was low, but a great temp at 44F. Fantastic near 60 degree March day. Good to be out. Best brookie was a blacked up 13.5"er. Happy Fishing!

An awesome outing here! Probably the best March outing I have ever had!! Stream temps were around 45F and the fish were cracking. At least 10+ browns 15" and up. Shebs had the fish of the outing, a 19", 4#+ fatty brown. I had an 18" to hand. We both lost bigger fish too. There is a brown here that comes and then loops around a log that I manage to coax out and land. Awesome shot I do say so myself. haha. There are also a few nice brookies and probably 25+ fish total. There are a few F works here, so please don't watch if that offends you. Also, it is windy in Wisconsin in spring. Wind suppression is on and I am not sure how well a mic muff will work, but that may be a future attempt. 9 out of 10 outings, the Sony wind protection works great. Today, the 15+ mph east wing directly in my face could not be suppressed. Happy fishing!

Well, I went big brown hunting, but only found brookies on this longish low end river wade. Best brookie was 13.75". 30 or so fish to hand,. Nice weather today with highs near 60. A great outing here with Shebs. 2nd 20 of the season. 7 more browns in the 17-19" range and a bunch of brookies to boot. Around 40 to hand here on a very long wade in stiff current. I was gassed by the end and my memory card cut off from being full. Water temp was 57F and the fish were slow at first and then aggressive. Happy fishing!!

Late, late afternoon drop in here. I came across a car at every bridge in prime spots for five miles on this stream. Got in with the hopes of locating a big brown. Came across many 7-8" brookies and then 1 big brown! 3rd 20 of the season. I was economical and fast here due to the time of day, but it paid off. Classic low number, big fish place. Looks like some heavy rain coming this way. Fishing was shaping up very well. Hopefully no major flooding. Happy fishing!
Pretty down weekend in the area. Some spots had 3" of rain and the weather change has been rough. missed a bigger fish here and just a few to hand. Better days ahead. Happy Fishing!

My buddy Nick and I set off on outing here. Had to move to plan B. 40-50 fish to hand. The fish here hovered in the 12" brown and 10" brookie range. Slow start on a long wade. Good times. Happy fishing!

Well, trout and 30th Wedding Anniversary vacation has started! In WI, the last three nights had freezing temps return. It did not get much over 40F. Expectations were low today. A pretty slow outing had several gems. Shebs lands a new PB brook trout and we had a dbl 20" day too. There is a full debut of Shebscam here with some editing learning too. Shebscam in full effect here. Trout vacation continues! I am getting a bit better on multicam situations. This outing started painfully slow, but picked up on the back end. Weather has crashed a bit with some rain and colder water temps in the mid 40sF. 19, 18 and other teens browns. Many brookies as well. Water that was brown dominant last time is now brookies 6 to 1 at least. Happy fishing!!

Trout vacation continues. Shebs and I are back at it again! The weather remains unstable. Cold with high temps at right around 40F made for a slow start with some sluggish fish. Things did heat up and many brookies and browns to hand. No giants, but many upper teens browns and nice brookies in the 12 to 14.5" range. Still polishing up some of the dual cam editing. Learned how to select primary catch angler as the big view. Also sizing and moving PIP so screen view remains good. Most comments have been positive on PIP. I like it, but it does make double the editing work. Probably gonna take a day for rest as Sun weather looks worse...snow! Happy fishing!

Trout vacation continues! Was on the prowl for big browns. Found a nice 19.25", but things were pretty slow, Lost several nice fish. A short commentary on wading and a turtle. Celebrating my 30th wedding anniversary with my loving wife tomorrow!! Happy fishing!!!
Trout vacation continues. 30th wedding anniversary today! 8th 20"+ brown of the year so far. 20 or so to hand. The rain held off most if the morning and the fish were eager!! Happy fishing!!!

Got together with fellow utuber Rob. A nice outing here. Things started slow with a hot middle, hot middle-end and then a dead end as the weather front passed through. No giants, but many nice fish to hand and good time had by all. Happy fishing!

Well, what can I say, this is my least favorite time of year to fish. Between traffic, crowds and trampled littered streams, I still managed to have some fun with Shebs and Nick. First try was a total bust, ended up low with some brookies. No world records here. Between a pandemic and a 90 degree opening Saturday, I have never seen such a busy opener. Happy fishing!

Well, trying to hit some less pounded area on the opener weekend. The less beaten path was still hit, but not nearly as heavy. Small brookies and few browns here today. Missed a hookup with a larger brown, good footage of that here! Happy fishing!!

A late afternoon stab in the dark on new water. Even at this low section, the stream was tiny. Found a few small brookies and then came upon a giant beaver dam that gave up a 14 and14.5 among other nice ones. Otherwise, a pretty wade and walk in the woods. Happy Fishing!

Nick and I are back at it. First stop was complete bust! Strange days, every day can't be a record breaker and this one was slow. A few decent brookies and browns, but most were on the smaller size. We keep on keeping on :) Happy fishing!!

Happy Mothers' Day! Shebs and I managed to have a decent brookie outing today. Best fish were topping out near 15" with quite a sporadic bite. Slow to start and then popping! Multiple cameras at work here. Happy fishing!!
A brookie effort here. Missed a few bigger fish. Several 13-14" range to hand. Bushwhacking on a small stream, fun times! Happy Fishing!!

Shebs and I here on a nice outing. Some very nice brookies, including a blacked out, roided, 14.5"er. Several bigger browns as well with an 18 and 19 topping the list. Headed north for the last spring steelhead chance this weekend. Happy fishing!
This trip was a good one, the seemed to drop in north of the drop point, probably land owner permission.

Shebs and I continued from where i exited the stream yesterday. As the outing continued we managed to get a decent resident fish bite. I managed several nice browns in the 17-18 range. No steelhead in sight. Beautiful day and good times. We are off to Sasquatch's ranch and will be out again tomorrow! Happy fishing!!

Shebs finds the lone steelhead the trip on this outing and he weekend. Sasquatch and I were taken to school! hahaha. Will be back for the fall lake run fish, spring 2021 kinda sucked for wading and spin fishing up north. Happy Fishing!!!

Time for something different. Rain continues to affect most trout streams in the area. I teamed up with my buddy Tim and we hit the big muddy in his boat! Limit of walleye and a nice pike boated. Tim came across a large bowfin and a few jumbo perch as well. Great weather and good times! Happy fishing!!

Well hot flames from hell! 99F today. I got out early to try and beat the heat, but it was still 73F at 6am, Yikes! A very good outing here with many nice timber smashing browns and brookies. I would have rated this one excellent, but I lost an 18" that was hooked fleetingly and a 20+ (could have been #9) that shook off when I slipped on clay. Oh well, at least I was hydrated and avoided sunburn. The heat was oppressive by noon when I biked back to the car. Happy fishing!

I eventually settled into a small stream brookie spot. In the tight spaces, I had three bigger browns outwork me! Plenty of gorgeous fish to hand, Happy fishing!!

Went on a very long slog today. The temperatures stayed under 90F and the wind was pleasant. Blue bird skies didn't seem to bother the trout. Average fish was coming in at about a 10" brown. However, there are many nicer fish here too. Had one big swipe and not connect. Best brown was 17.5". Several 16s 15s and 14s too. Toss in a few brookies as well. Thought I might hit a tiger, but that did not pan out! Happy fishing!!

Shebs and I got out on yet another very warm day. #9 Brown over 20" is here. This one is a beasty, 22-24" and 5#+. Unfortunately I was unable to control the fish with two bare hands as she leaped from my grasp. Many other nice browns. The water here was so clear and the direct sun made the fish very vigilant. Saw many fish just following and not striking. Shebs, lands a 19 and several other quality fish are located. Happy fishing!

An evening fish here with many brookies and a few nice browns scattered in. The water here was low and weeds had grown in direct sunlight areas of the stream. Lower spots on this system were dirty due to recent heavy rains. We need the rain. My hope is we have rain on Mondays and Tuesdays only :) Hahaha. 30+ fish here and a pretty active bite. Daylight will begin to recede and eventually trigger some of the spawn to get underway. Best fishing of the year is yet to come! Happy fishing!!

 Shebs and I hit a clear section of water here. It was a bit of a challenge to find! Recent welcome rains have muddied things up in the area. We were waiting on a tanker brown to emerge. Shebs did latch on to an 18 or so, but this outing was dominated with mid size browns and some nicer brook trout. First fish of the outing was a beautiful 14.75" sparkling brookie! Happy fishing!

Happy 4th of July holiday! Number 10 over 20 eluded me yesterday. Today #10 was delivered. This stream was 60F at entry and the quality of the brookies was excellent. I landed a 5#+ 21.75" brown near some ancient habitat imporvemnt. Several brookies at 15" Nice outing on a warm day. Happy fishing!

A nice brown trout outing here with dinker brookies tossed in. I landed #11 ova 20" here and lost an even bigger one to boot. The water was somewhat clear, then filthy, then fireworks at the very end. Some slo mo and acrobatics here. Happy Fishing!

I started at 6am or so today to get to cooler stream temps. Water at the first stop was 57F and 60F at the second. A high quality outing ensued with plan B. Had a multi species experience with a 17.5" smallmouth, two pike 16" & 25", and brown trout. Here the browns presented larger than average. A19, 2 18, 3 17s and 5+ 15-16 in addition to some dinks. About 25 fish to hand. You will also see quite a beaver display here, all three being very well fed. Some nice slowmo here too. Happy fishing!

Shebs and I traversed the countryside on this afternoon. The search was for the coolest water we could locate. Temps ranged from 65 to 69 on most streams this afternoon. These are not great temps for trout fishing, Most fish will be hunkered down in springs or under cover in temps this high. This is great outing on a small stream. For less than three hours angling, we managed a 16", 15.5" and several 15-13" brookies. Happy fishing!

A hot and steamy morning on the prowl for brookies. Some slo mo on a 16-18" brookie here. Some nice 14 and 15s to hand. This kind of of small stream is ne of my very favorite ways to angle brook trout. Happy fishing!

Late afternoon was spent trying to target some brookies. There were dinks, chubs, some nice brookies and one giant here that has some nice slomo footage. Looking forward to the spawn setting up in the next couple months. Best fishing of the year is now until the end of season. Happy Fishing!
You can see the lower part of the bridge, nothing unique to identify here

Another late afternoon evening fish here. Headed back to the same stream I Ieft off at to try for some nicer brookies. Here we have some chubs and dinks again with a few nice ones mixed in. Some very cool sweeping fish action near the end. Fish continued to nip and this stream has been impacted severly by past flooding. A looming major rain event may sideline things in the driftless for while. Stay tuned and happy fishing!

Brookie hunt day 2! Some stained water where I have had some success before tempted me today!! I was rewarded with an excellent fat 16"er and had chances at 4 others in the similar size range. Whether the cold front or stain, many fish were nipping today and aggression was lacking. Many lip hooked and easily lost fish. Happy fishing!

Well a very long slog here. Tried to get to the back half of a very long section where I encountered some bigger brookies. A 16.25" to hand here and a million dinks. Stellar weather and 3L of water was not enough. About three quarters in, for whatever reason, I was plagued with some vicious dbl muscle dbl leg cramps. Ugh! Couldn't pedal the bike uphill, but at least most of the 3.2 miles back tot he fishmobile was downhill! Happy Fishing, stay hydrated, spay and neuter your pets!! Hahahaha

Well, after two long slog days of nothing burger, I finally hit a chromer! My first stop was a complete bust from sunrise to 9am or so. As I began my trip back home, I decided to stop for a final attempt. Not exactly sure, but I suspect that many lake run fish remain in bays and stream mouths. The extended drought and warm temperatures are not signaling a clear spawn run for salmon. Once the salmon come in, all other trout will follow to munch on salmon eggs. It just hasn't happened yet from my experience. Anyway, a nice 26.5" steelhead here. I may get one more stint up north. Inland season is closed. Dark days ahead! Hahaha!! Happy fishing!!!

Well the new season is upon us in WI. We have had some brutal weather with -25 F for a low a day ago. Water here was iced some, but the water was 38.8F. Two fish to hand and one additional biter. One fish in January is a win folks! Thanks for watching and happy fishing!

Well, here is a January outing for the records. There are 19.5" and 19" browns here. At first glance thought I may have had my second ever January 20"er. Still a cpl fantastic fat female browns! Welcome to the ice breaking show! Continued colder than normal February temperatures made things rough this weekend. Even with strong south winds, last Saturday was plainly unfishable due to temps in the teens and wind chill near zero. Oddly, it had been warmest on overnights, very strange for a WI winter. Dog days of summer continue. Multiple spots here with several fish to hand, but things remain slow. As summer evenings begin to turn cooler, the fishing will improve and migration to best spawning areas of streams will occur. This movement is not predictable on inland streams. Inland trout do not have a salmon-like neonatal imprint that urges return to spawning areas. On inland streams, the best spawning territory may 50 yards or 5 miles away from spring and summer feeding zones. Trout will move in the stream system for food, ideal water temps and best spawning territory. Generally, that is the priority level, except spawning areas will become #1 in the fall as the urge to reproduce develops and climaxes. Better days ahead! Happy fishing!!

Adam and I get out in front of guess what...more heavy rain expected in WI. Streams were at banks earlier his week. Fewer options, so we stayed close by (for me). Dirty, but fishable, water produced a few decent browns. Broke another pole. Extremely poor plan B. You may think dirty high water could harm trout, but it does not. Dirty, high water hold lotsa food for trout that has been flushed into the streams from fertile banks. Worms, bugs, seeds, etc. I am pretty sure we had a day here where all the fish were fed on other sources and they did not need to work and seek out metal tidbits to eat. Happy fishing!

Decided to take a solo look at a local stream that had a large fish kill three seasons ago. I was happy to see fish interested right at the in bridge. Hot bite with 60+ to hand. Lotsa smalls in the 5-9" range. I did get a 15" and probably had 10 fish at 12 or better. I saw two upper teens fish swipe but no hook up! Miraculously, I actually caught a brook trout here. First one ever in 13+ years. This is awesome for a stream that had no trace of trout over the past 3 years!! The spill that causes the kill was organic, so not a toxin. My guess is that most of these fish were stocked and growing over the past three years. This stream is capable of producing large browns and hopefully it's on the mend. Happy fishing!!!

Here you can get a close up of what a recent WI DNR HI (habitat improvement) area looks like shortly after it was completed. This HI is done well, but I am not a huge fan of the "golf course" method. This class one stream was forested and now it's deforested. Perhaps they will plant some saplings of white willow or other native stream trees when planting time is best. It is clear to me though that there will be some improvements: flood control, erosion control, decreased sediment load, increase stream flow, and perhaps better brown trout spawning area (not lacking anyway). This stream is already in the very cold zone for trout streams and it will likely remain cold even with the deforestation. A few fish to hand in the greater than 1 mile HI and then fishing in the adjacent unimproved stream. Happy fishing!

Happy fishing!

There still was dirty water in the area today, the frost is gone, but winter is not over in Wisconsin yet :)  I broke a trout fishing rule on this trip. RULE: Never abandon a spot/plan when the fish are biting where you are. Plan A had two fat chunky browns - 16" and 15" males in the first ten casts! And I decided not to make the long wade. I did consider the aforementioned rule. My issue on the long wade is that this stream is pushing a tremendous CFS for a driftless wading stream, the water was up, the water was stained in holes, a bite lull..... But in the end my decision was based on not wanting to take the 6 hour wade (more if u r catching!). I am getting older folks. Anyway, went to a smaller clear spot, but the river was predominately flat sand. A few to hand. I will keep at it folks and as always thanks and happy fishing!
